name: noctcore/eslint-plugins
headline: Catch bugs that compile.
subline: Focused rule families for what generic linters miss.
alt: noctcore/eslint-plugins. Catch bugs that compile. Focused rule families for what generic linters miss.
description: Source code passes three plugin families on its way to a clean lint run. The contracts plugin stops a fetch whose response is never checked, async-safety stops a fetch with no timeout, and security stops shell interpolation.
